infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: WeaveNYC uses the camera to scan QR codes for verified anchors and to attach photos to posts.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: WeaveNYC uses the microphone to record short voice notes for posts and chat.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: WeaveNYC uses your location to show nearby resources like food pantries, clinics, and housing help.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: WeaveNYC uses your photo library to let you attach images to posts.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: WeaveNYC can add trusted neighbors to your contacts, with your permission.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: WeaveNYC can use Face ID to lock your verified session.
